target.title: fix(agents): reject aborted foreground exec with AbortError
target.body:
Closes #105681

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where canceling a foreground `exec` tool call via the agent `AbortSignal` still fulfilled the tool result as a normal process exit/failure payload. The agent manager could treat the tool as completed instead of aborted, so cancellation did not cleanly surface as an abort error on the tool path.

## Why This Change Was Made

Foreground abort already kills the child process, but the wrapper promise still resolved through `buildExecForegroundResult` after the process exited. This change records caller abort for foreground runs, clears any armed yield timer before kill (so the timer cannot resolve a "running" result first), waits for the existing process finalization promise, then rejects with the signal reason or a canonical `AbortError`. Backgrounded/yielded sessions remain detached and are not killed by the tool-turn abort. Timeouts and ordinary non-abort process failures still use the existing normalized result path.

**Fix quality check:** compatibility — no config/API surface change; performance — O(1) flag/timer clear on abort only; usability — abort surfaces as `AbortError` instead of a misleading completed tool result; security — no trust-boundary change.

## User Impact

When an operator or agent runtime cancels a foreground bash/exec tool mid-run, the tool promise rejects with `AbortError` after process finalization instead of returning a successful-looking failed/exit tool payload. Backgrounded process sessions are unchanged.

## Evidence

Verification host: **local macOS**.

Branch refreshed onto current `main` (`merge(main)` → `11f1b1eef` / `11f1b1eef2b71efd58281348bde2cee02c7180e9`; base `1b43d7144`).

### Non-test real exec cancellation (terminal transcript)

Standalone `tsx` driver calling production `createExecTool` against a real shell child (no Vitest harness). AbortSignal fired on the first `onUpdate` for a multi-step shell command.

```text
### Real behavior proof transcript (PR #106422)
date_utc=2026-07-13T14:41:45Z
note=non-test terminal run of createExecTool against real shell; abort on first onUpdate
host=local-macos
platform=darwin
node=v24.17.0
head=11f1b1eef2b71efd58281348bde2cee02c7180e9
branch=fix/105681-exec-abort-reject
loader=tsx createExecTool (no vitest harness; real shell child process)

=== scenario: foreground-abort ===
[onUpdate #1] aborting tool turn (operator cancel / AbortSignal)
REJECTED name=AbortError
REJECTED message=This operation was aborted
REJECTED isAbortError=true
onUpdateCount=1
elapsedMs=1066

=== scenario: yield-window-abort ===
[onUpdate #1] aborting tool turn (operator cancel / AbortSignal)
REJECTED name=AbortError
REJECTED message=This operation was aborted
REJECTED isAbortError=true
onUpdateCount=1
elapsedMs=127

=== control: non-abort success still fulfills ===
SUCCESS status=completed
SUCCESS text_has_ok=true

=== done ===
script_exit=0
```

### Focused regression checks after main merge

```text
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.test.ts -t "abort"
# Test Files  2 passed (2)
# Tests  8 passed | 62 skipped (70)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec.background-abort.test.ts
# Test Files  1 passed (1)
# Tests  7 passed (7)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs packages/agent-core/src/agent-loop.test.ts -t "does not request another model turn after a tool aborts"
# Tests  1 passed | 24 skipped
# (aborted tool does not request another model turn)
```

Static:

```text
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD   # clean after merge
```

## Real behavior proof

- Behavior addressed: Caller abort of a foreground exec tool must reject with `AbortError` after process finalization, not fulfill a normal foreground result; yield timer must not win the race and resolve "running". Agent-loop path must not request another model turn after a tool abort.
- Environment: local macOS, Node v24.17.0, checkout `openclaw` at branch `fix/105681-exec-abort-reject` (`11f1b1eef` after merge with current main), real shell via production `createExecTool` (tsx driver) plus focused Vitest suites.
- Current-main contrast: On unpatched main, `onAbortSignal` only `run.kill()`s; `run.promise.then` still `resolve(buildExecForegroundResult(...))` for non-backgrounded runs, so abort fulfills as a normal tool result.
- Exact steps after this patch:
  1. Non-test: `tsx` script constructs `createExecTool({ host: "gateway", security: "full", ask: "off" })`, runs `echo before-abort; sleep 0.5; echo after-abort`, aborts on first `onUpdate` → observe `REJECTED name=AbortError`.
  2. Same with `yieldMs: 60_000` armed → still `AbortError` (not a "running" fulfillment).
  3. Control: non-abort `echo ok-not-aborted` still completes successfully.
  4. Focused Vitest: foreground abort suite (8), background-abort suite (7), agent-loop "no another model turn" (1).
- Evidence after fix: Non-test transcript shows `isAbortError=true` for both foreground and yield-window scenarios; control success path unchanged. Focused suites all green after main merge.
- Control check: background abort tests still pass (tool abort does not kill already-backgrounded sessions); non-abort foreground success still fulfills.
- Observed result after fix: Foreground abort rejects after process finalization; yield-timer race does not resolve a running payload; backgrounded sessions remain intact; aborted tools do not request another model turn.
- What was not tested: Full interactive multi-step OpenClaw agent session with operator `/stop` in a live channel UI; live paid model transcript.

## Linked context

Open non-ready linked PR #105726 also targets this issue (`status: needs proof`). This PR follows the same direction (post-finalization AbortError + yield timer clear) using the shared `createAbortError` helper on a branch refreshed against current main.
